exact: regulation of synaptic plasticity by receptor localisation to synapse

definition: Any process that modulates synaptic plasticity, the ability of synapses to change as circumstances require, via receptor localization to the synapse, the junction between a nerve fiber of one neuron and another neuron or muscle fiber or glial cell. Processes may include receptor transport to, and/or maintenance at, the synapse.
label: regulation of synaptic plasticity by receptor localization to synapse
